h1: The service record that is photos of your living room

criteria.h1: The service record that is photos of your living room
tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for service businesses (plugin version 4.0.3). WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. A Tuesday someone-home window or an annual recert slot is a booking you create; a service name such as flue inspection or creosote sweep is a label you configure. Neither is a documented default. Address, access-note, home-window, interior-photo, condition-report, or insurer-forward questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, input, or checkbox); they are not documented defaults. A booking is a calendar row, not proof anyone was home or that a flue was inspected — and a CSV export of "12 Oak St · access: side gate · window Tue 10am someone home · photos: fireplace.jpg flue.jpg living-room.jpg · creosote heavy · cert → insurer" next to a customer name is still a calendar that pairs living-room photos with an insurer-bound condition note. Emails can include those custom fields and copy the appointment off-site. An optional GDPR setting can auto-remove customer data older than six months; that is not a default purge. Google Calendar, SMS, and payments are Pro. Google reCAPTCHA is optional. Public booking-form browser hosts are unverified. | Chimney-sweep bookings stored on your WordPress site | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv4.0.3 readme.txt (SVN)

Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form BuilderDocumented self-hosted form builder (plugin version 1.58.1). The listing states Forminator stores and organizes submissions so you can sort, analyze, and manage responses, and includes a free file-upload field with multi-file support. Version 1.58.1 helper-fields.php forminator_upload_root() writes under the WordPress uploads directory plus /forminator/, with per-form hashed subfolders from forminator_get_upload_path(). upload.php stores files through that path. Address, access-note, home-window, interior-photo, condition-report, or insurer-forward fields are fields you add; they are not documented defaults. Completing the form can store an address-plus-photo-plus-condition stack ("12 Oak St · access: side gate · window Tue 10am someone home · photos: fireplace.jpg flue.jpg living-room.jpg · creosote heavy · cert → insurer") — typed once so a sweep can certify a flue, into the same tables as a "chimney sweep" label. A photo or condition answer is a form answer or uploaded file, not a verified certification. A sweep booking is a calendar row, not proof anyone was home — and a staff login can open "Jordan, 12 Oak St, fireplace.jpg, living-room.jpg, creosote heavy, cert → insurer" next to everyone else's resume. Notification emails can copy field values and files off-site. Optional Stripe, PayPal, HubSpot, Mailchimp, and webhook integrations send data only when you enable them. Public form-page browser hosts are unverified. | Address, access, photo, and condition answers stored in WordPress; optional photos in the site uploads/forminator folder | Browser hosts not verified | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv1.58.1 readme.txt (SVN)v1.58.1 helper-fields.php (upload root)v1.58.1 upload.php

PixelYourSite – Your smart PIXEL (TAG) & API ManagerDocumented pixel and tag manager (plugin version 11.4.2.1). When a Meta Pixel ID is saved, version 11.4.2.1 dist/scripts/public.js loads https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js. A noscript image uses https://www.facebook.com/tr. Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Head and Footer scripts load only when you enable them. Automated events include form submissions; those events do not by themselves prove that an address, interior-photo, or condition-report field was sent. A page request from this script is not proof anyone booked a sweep. The page URL can say chimney sweep even when no form is submitted. Consent timing has not been tested. Review which tags you enable on booking and report pages. | Marketing tags handled through Meta, Google, or other configured platforms | connect.facebook.net | Not assessed | Not tested | None | WordPress.org listingv11.4.2.1 readme.txt (SVN)v11.4.2.1 public.js (fbevents.js)
